## Look

Backlog items are now composer ideas. The dashboard panel, the handoff view and the engage skill read composer:idea. The score module no longer declares backlog-item or feedback. The live store holds 21 composer:idea records with the old ids and validates. Read the check-runs for the conversion, retired-type and view tests, and the live validate output.

## Machine

- 21 acceptances pass at 96bed416eda01597d07ff4575adb85a57123acf9.
- Review check-run backlog-to-idea-review: pass at 96bed416eda01597d07ff4575adb85a57123acf9 (first review found one minor missing test; fix landed; re-review passed).
- Suite backlog-to-idea-suite: pass at 96bed416eda01597d07ff4575adb85a57123acf9. One earlier run failed on a timing flake in tests/test_dashboard_app.py that passes alone.
- Integration-report backlog-to-idea: pass at 96bed416eda01597d07ff4575adb85a57123acf9.

## Attention

- The conversion ran as a one-off rename (apply_steps), not a versioned migration. A clone with an old score snapshot needs the same rename by hand.
- A Cursor worker changed orchestra/canon/cli.py to satisfy a frozen oracle query. The parent reverted it and amended the oracle to query --state active.
- The suite gate is now advisory in .canon/config.json, set at the user's request.
